documents.body:
# Aster release current operating decision

## Adopted decision
Aster release requires two distinct reviewers and records the signed change manifest.

## Related operations
Build artifacts are retained for 14 days after release.

## Authority and exception
The release coordinator authorizes the next step; a missing signature blocks deployment.

## Routine review
The staging job checks Linux and macOS packages independently.

## Recovery or closure
A rollback restores the previous manifest before traffic is reopened.

documents.title: Quail freezer response matrix
documents.body:
# Quail freezer response matrix

## Applicable measurement
This matrix applies to temperature in the Quail freezer system. Use the class written on the device or queue label; do not infer a class from the reading.

## Trigger matrix
Class | Trigger at or above | Unit | Response
|---|---:|---|---|
| Q1 | -1 | degrees C | notify the local operator |
| Q2 | 2 | degrees C | request a second reading |
| Q3 | 5 | degrees C | notify the local operator |
| Q4 | 8 | degrees C | isolate the affected tray |
| Q5 | 11 | degrees C | notify the local operator |
| Q6 | 14 | degrees C | request a second reading |
| Q7 | 17 | degrees C | notify the local operator |
| Q8 | 20 | degrees C | request a second reading |
| Q9 | 23 | degrees C | notify the local operator |
| Q10 | 26 | degrees C | request a second reading |
| Q11 | 29 | degrees C | notify the local operator |
| Q12 | 32 | degrees C | request a second reading |

## Rehearsal exception
During a declared defrost rehearsal, record the reading but do not perform the matrix response; the duty engineer must confirm the drill identifier.

## Return to service
After an operational response, the duty engineer records a stable follow-up reading before releasing the affected equipment or queue.

## Sampling
Use the latest validated reading. A missing or invalid reading is reported to the instrument owner instead of being treated as zero.

documents.body:
# Quail freezer unadopted alternate matrix

## Alternate proposal
A supplier proposed doubling every Quail freezer trigger and suppressing the drill identifier check.

## Status

documents.title: Cobalt shift handoff procedure
documents.body:
# Cobalt shift handoff procedure

## Package contents
The Cobalt shift handoff must include the unresolved-alert register.

## Completion gate
Do not mark the Cobalt shift transfer complete until the incoming shift lead records a signed receipt in the shift log.

## Responsibility before receipt
Until that receipt is recorded, the outgoing shift lead remains responsible for unresolved work.

## Delivery failure
If the delivery channel fails, keep the transfer pending and resend the same package identifier. A resend is not a new transfer.

## Receipt correction
If a receipt names the wrong package, attach a correction and request confirmation from the receiving role before completing the transfer.

# Dune expedition handoff procedure

## Package contents
The Dune expedition handoff must include the equipment discrepancy list.

## Completion gate
Do not mark the Dune expedition transfer complete until the field coordinator records an acknowledgement linked to the manifest.

## Responsibility before receipt
Until that receipt is recorded, the dispatch coordinator remains responsible for unresolved work.

## Delivery failure
If the delivery channel fails, keep the transfer pending and resend the same package identifier. A resend is not a new transfer.

## Receipt correction
If a receipt names the wrong package, attach a correction and request confirmation from the receiving role before completing the transfer.

documents.body:
# Kite notebook shared access policy

## Access boundary
Kite notebook contents are private to owner-kite; nonowners may receive only this shared access policy.

## Review route
A nonowner can request an access review through the records custodian; submitting a request does not grant access.

## Audit record
Access reviews record the requesting actor and decision time without copying the private contents into the shared register.
